title: DC Hub Works with: who owns what, where DC Hub sends the reader

partners.name: datacenterHawk
partners.owns: Market intelligence on colocation supply, demand and lease and sale transactions: datasets, analytics and expert research on one platform.
partners.dchub_supplies: Live grid, interconnection-queue and power context for the same markets, dated and source-named.
partners.route_back: Leasing comps and market supply research: use datacenterHawk.

partners.name: DC Byte
partners.owns: Market analytics, hyperscaler and supplier analytics, a site selector, consultancy and reports on global data centre coverage.
partners.dchub_supplies: Power-side evidence (grid headroom, queue position, time to power) to read beside its supply data.
partners.route_back: Supply and pipeline analytics across its markets: use DC Byte.

partners.name: Data Center Dynamics (DCD)
partners.owns: Industry news, long reads, whitepapers and live events such as DCD Connect.
partners.dchub_supplies: Dated, cited power and grid figures a story or briefing can link to.
partners.route_back: News, events and DCD research: go to DCD.

partners.name: Data Center Frontier (DCF)
partners.owns: News and analysis on hyperscale, colocation, power, cooling and AI infrastructure, plus podcasts, webinars, white papers and the DCF Trends Summit.
partners.dchub_supplies: A live market power card and cited grid figures to embed beside a story.
partners.route_back: Reporting and analysis: go to Data Center Frontier.

partners.name: Baxtel
partners.owns: A map and directory of data center facilities, with news, datasets, a colocation inventory service and property-selling and site-selection services.
partners.dchub_supplies: Power and grid context for the sites a directory lists, with the source named on every figure.
partners.route_back: Facility and provider listings: use Baxtel.

partners.name: CBRE
partners.owns: Commercial real estate services across leasing, sales, capital markets and research, with a Data Center Solutions offering.
partners.dchub_supplies: A cited power and queue figure to sit beside a market view between report editions.
partners.route_back: Representation, market reports and deal execution: work with CBRE.

partners.name: JLL
partners.owns: Data center real estate and infrastructure advisory, from site selection and utility power procurement to facility operations, with published market reports.
partners.dchub_supplies: A cited power and queue figure to sit beside a market view between report editions.
partners.route_back: Representation, market reports and deal execution: work with JLL.
